summary: Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a routine quarterly dividend declaration of $0.268 per share on its common shares, payable October 26, 2026, to holders of record September 25, 2026. The board declared the dividend in a July 29, 2026 press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or restructuring are present; this is an ordinary dividend announcement by the issuer. There are no deal terms, advisors, premiums, or regulatory processes involved. The filing is a standard current report with no implications for special-situations analysis.
